issues.title: French-speaking nations hold a summit in Cambodia as a conflict in Africa threatens a rift
issues.title_en: French-speaking nations hold a summit in Cambodia as a conflict in Africa threatens a rift
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH, Cambodia (AP) - Emmanuel Macron is set to attend a biennial meeting of French-speaking territories beginning on Saturday in Cambodia, where the French president contending with public unrest at home will face international political challenges as a conflict in Africa hangs over the proceedings.
